title: The Kitchen of Rosewater Lane
author: Oscar Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
